verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API spec for ObsessionDB. The llms.txt and docs.md probes are machine-readable documentation rather than an API specification. The MCP server and ClickHouse HTTP protocol compatibility are related features, not a published spec, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
